How to Use Text Cleaner

1

Key Features & Capabilities

Remove Extra Spaces

Collapses multiple consecutive spaces and tabs into a single clean space.

Strip HTML Tags

Removes all <div>, <p>, <a>, and other tags while preserving raw text content.

Remove Line Breaks

Merges broken paragraphs into continuous flowing text.

About This Tool

Copying and pasting text from PDFs, websites, or emails often brings along messy line breaks, redundant spaces, unwanted HTML tags, and weird formatting. Our Text Cleaner fixes all these issues instantly with configurable cleaning filters.
